title: Edit pages open as intercepting routes in an @modal parallel slot
decision: Team, player and lineup edit flows use Next.js intercepting routes rendered into an `@modal` parallel slot. A soft navigation to an edit URL opens the form over the tab content and updates the URL; a hard navigation falls through to the full workspace route. Every slot provides a `default.tsx` returning `null`.
context: Edit pages rendered as parallel slots inside the tab shell, with the bottom navigation still visible.

alternatives.option: An inline modal without URL changes
alternatives.reason: Simpler, with no intercepting routes or parallel slots, but it breaks browser back and direct links and makes navigation state harder to test.

consequences: Browser back, direct links and sharing work, and one route definition serves both the modal and the workspace.
Parallel and intercepting routes carry cache and hard-refresh edge cases; the workspace route is the hard-refresh fallback.
